column1:
A few showers are likely in the sea areas off the coast extending from Hambantota to Trincomalee
via Batticaloa. Showers or thundershowers are likely at a few places in the sea areas off the coast
extending from Colombo to Matara via Galle during the evening or night.

Winds will be easterly to northeasterly. Wind speed will be (20-30) kmph.
Wind speed can increase up to 40 kmph at times in the sea areas off the coast extending from
Mannar to Colombo via Puttalam and from Matara to Pottuvil.

The sea areas off the coast extending from Mannar to Colombo via Puttalam and from Matara to
Pottuvil will be moderate at times. The other sea areas around the island will be slight.
